business_problem: Managing Malaysia’s 5G network and its diverse systems while maintaining resilience, availability, and reliable connectivity for consumers and businesses.
solution_summary: Ericsson developed the AI intent-based operations (IBO) solution for Digital Nasional Berhad and integrated it into Malaysia’s 5G network, including the 5G Multi-Operator Core Network (MOCN). The source describes an operational capability rather than a detailed data pipeline: IBO uses 5G Advanced standards, machine learning, and automation to streamline network management, support resilience and security, and make operations more agile and easier to manage. The network offers businesses customized connectivity through network slices with specific Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Ericsson’s AI-powered operations support the MOCN’s six mobile operators, with the stated aim of ensuring smooth network management, high availability, and seamless integration across diverse systems. The source does not identify data inputs, model architecture, storage, serving interfaces, or specific integrated systems.
